# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph Arrives at Pentephres' House

---

**2:1** And it came-to-pass when Pentephres heard that Joseph was coming to him, he said to Aseneth his daughter: "Behold, Joseph the Powerful-One of God is coming to us today. Go into your upper chamber and stay there, and do not show yourself to him."

**2:2** "For Joseph is a man who worships God, and he is self-controlled, and he does not suffer any woman who is a stranger to be near him — for he does not suffer any woman to speak with him. But we will bring him in and he will dine with us, and you shall see him from above through the latticed-window, and you will perhaps take pleasure in seeing him."

**2:3** And when Aseneth heard the words of her father, she was very glad and said: "If it is so, then let him come, and I will look at him through the latticed-window."

**2:4** And Aseneth hurried and adorned herself with her finest garments and with her golden adornments, and she arranged her hair and put upon her head a golden diadem and golden bracelets around her hands.

**2:5** And she put on garments embroidered with gold and fine linen, and she put on her feet sandals of gold, and she adorned herself with all the adornments of a virgin.

**2:6** And she went up to the upper chamber and stood beside the eastern window, so that she might see Joseph coming to her father's house.

**2:7** And behold, a chariot-of-white-horses came, and Joseph was riding in it, and the chariot was decked with gold and the horses were white like snow.

**2:8** And Joseph was clothed in a white tunic, and a white robe was cast about him, and on his head was a golden crown, and around the crown were twelve selected stones, and above the twelve stones were twelve golden rays.

**2:9** And Joseph held in his right hand a royal scepter of olive-wood, and in his left hand he held an olive-branch stretched out, which bore fruits in abundance, and on the fruits was much oil.

**2:10** And Joseph came to Pentephres' house, and Pentephres and his wife and all his household went out to meet Joseph and bowed low before him to the earth.

**2:11** And Joseph descended from the chariot and gave his right hand to Pentephres.

**2:12** And Aseneth saw Joseph and was deeply moved, and her soul was dissolved, and her knees were loosened, and she trembled in her whole body and was afraid, and she said in her heart: "What now shall I do, miserable-woman that I am? Did I not say that Joseph is coming — the son of a shepherd from the land of Canaan — and now behold, the sun from the heavens has come to us in his chariot and entered our house?"

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
